message.subject: Materials question for 3M R&D
message.body:
Hi [Name],

I saw 3M recently launched the Protection Wrap Film Color Series—congrats on the expansion.

I lead go-to-market for DuPont Tedlar's protective films. We're seeing more customers ask about performance beyond typical vinyl limitations, especially for transit and architectural applications where temperature extremes and graffiti resistance matter.

Would you be open to a technical briefing on how our PVF chemistry compares to vinyl-based approaches? Could be useful competitive intelligence for your team's roadmap.

Happy to share some field performance data if that's helpful.

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: 3M's recent Protection Wrap Film launch and active presence at industry trade shows suggests R&D is supporting product line expansion and needs competitive intelligence on emerging protective technologies
personalization_used.value_prop_emphasized: PVF chemistry advantages for harsh-environment applications (temperature extremes, graffiti resistance) positioned as competitive intelligence rather than sales pitch
